exceptions.justification: Confirmed live via direct curl (redirects to https://github.com/mozilla/inclusion with a final HTTP 200, 2026-09-19); linkinator intermittently reports it unreachable (HTTP 0, a connection-level failure distinct from the redirect) during CI's crawl, a transient GitHub network blip, not a genuine broken link.
